In part (d) most responses indicated a conceptual understanding that the total distance traveled by the particle over a time 
interval is found by integrating the particle’s speed over that time interval, but frequently there was a disconnect in considering 
the appropriate definite integral. 

What common student misconceptions or gaps in knowledge were seen in the responses to this 
question?
